meta.title: ComfyUI驱动工具
meta.description: Connect DSH tools to your own ComfyUI instances: instance management, tool assignment, MiniMax H3 video and Qwen Image 2.1 image generation & editing. (compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 ~ 0.2.1-rc.2)

en.assignNoticeText: Make sure the ComfyUI instance on this machine can run the ComfyUI workflow used by this tool.
en.deleteConfirm: Delete instance "{name}"? Its tool assignments will be cleared.
